title: Fasting Symptom Note Backlog
dataSources: Prayer sessions (`faith:rosary`), retreat events (`faith:retreat`), attendance logs (`faith:attendance`), fasting journals (`faith:fast`), practice reviews (`faith:ops`).
app: Spiritual-practice telemetry — rosary counters, meditation-retreat schedules, church-attendance logs, and fasting journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=faith:fast symptom_type=* note_state=*
| stats sum(eval(if(note_state!="reviewed",1,0))) as backlog, count as total by symptom_type
| where backlog>0
| sort - backlog
description: Lists pending fasting notes backlog by symptom type for fasting reviews.
value: Backlog counts expose where small unfinished tasks accumulate and create hidden drag inside fasting reviews.
implementation: Mark each `faith:fast` record with a pending-state flag and summarize backlog totals by `symptom_type`.
visualization: Table of symptom type with pending fasting notes counts.
grandmaExplanation: It blends where unfinished fasting notes are piling up so you can clear the biggest queues in fasting reviews.
